description: Let LAUNCH BOAT reach the canonical RBOAT-FUNCTION instead of being rejected by generic vehicle launch handling.

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE V-LAUNCH ()
	 <COND (<FSET? ,PRSO ,VEHBIT>
		<TELL "You can't launch that by saying \"launch\"!" CR>)
	       (T
		<TELL "That's pretty weird." CR>)>>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE V-LAUNCH ()
	 <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,INFLATED-BOAT>
		<RBOAT-FUNCTION>)
	       (<FSET? ,PRSO ,VEHBIT>
		<TELL "You can't launch that by saying \"launch\"!" CR>)
	       (T
		<TELL "That's pretty weird." CR>)>>
